model_and_aggregation.cell_inclusion: A grid cell is included when its center falls inside the Natural Earth 10m country polygon; boundary-edge partial-cell area is not clipped.
model_and_aggregation.regional_mean: Monthly suitability and season metrics use cosine(latitude)-weighted valid grid-cell observations; unweighted summaries are retained.
model_and_aggregation.suitable_month_count: Number of calendar months with suitability >= threshold.
model_and_aggregation.season_onset: First calendar month with suitability >= threshold among complete cell-years with at least one suitable month.
model_and_aggregation.season_end: Last calendar month with suitability >= threshold among complete cell-years with at least one suitable month.
model_and_aggregation.season_span: Last suitable month minus first suitable month plus one; it can exceed suitable-month count when suitable months are non-contiguous.
model_and_aggregation.longest_contiguous_run: Longest uninterrupted January–December run of suitable months; December-to-January wrap is not joined.
model_and_aggregation.missingness: No imputation. Values outside [0, 1], NaN, and -1 are treated as missing.
model_and_aggregation.uncertainty: No per-cell model uncertainty layer is supplied; quantiles, spread, valid counts, and missingness are descriptive variability indicators rather than confidence intervals.

interpretation_boundary.north_korea: Modeled extrapolation flag; no direct DPRK occurrence or surveillance records are included.
interpretation_boundary.south_korea_and_japan: Modeled regional suitability, not observed vector presence or abundance.
interpretation_boundary.all_geographies: Do not interpret as infection, disease incidence, human exposure, transmission risk, installation risk, or operational early warning.
